title: ProjectOS Watchdog Core Lock
description: watchdog-core.lock.json at a product repository root. Written only by projectos/scripts/watchdog-sync.cjs. Pins the vendored Watchdog Core to an exact reviewed release. Contains no credentials, no local filesystem paths and no product secrets. Hashes are SHA-256 of the file text with CRLF normalised to LF. Enforced by projectos/scripts/_watchdog-lib.cjs lockErrors().

install_path.description: Relative path of the vendored core inside the product.

files.description: Install-relative path -> SHA-256 (hex) of canonical text.
